title: Storybook Ui Missing Styles
description: Storybook UI (dev:storybook:ui) renders without styles — fix CSS/Tailwind/theme loading in Storybook preview.
summary: Storybook UI preview was unstyled because Tailwind v4 was not wired like other Vite apps: @theme tokens never resolved on :root (--foreground, --color-primary empty) so utilities and semantic colors did not apply. Added `.storybook/globals.css` importing `@semio-tech/ui-react/globals.css` with @source paths for ui/react, storybook stories, and sibling stacks; preview loads it for ui/compose/puzzle scopes. Registered `@tailwindcss/vite` and `uiAssetsVitePlugin` in `.storybook/main.ts` viteFinal. Verified in browser on :6015: Anta font, dark canvas, bordered button group, CSS vars populated. @semio-tech/ui-react tests pass (80).
